mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sub_app WHERE id = #{id} AND NOT deleted FOR UPDATE
SELECT environment AS key, remote_entry AS value FROM sub_app_entry WHERE sub_app_id = #{subAppId} ORDER BY environment
SELECT dependency AS key, min_version AS value FROM sub_app_requirement WHERE sub_app_id = #{subAppId} ORDER BY dependency
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sub_app_entry (sub_app_id, environment, remote_entry) VALUES (#{subAppId}, #{row.key}, #{row.value})
INSERT INTO sub_app_requirement (sub_app_id, dependency, min_version) VALUES (#{subAppId}, #{row.key}, #{row.value})
